g.text: Load Balancing — what L4 vs L7 can actually see
Same client request, routed by two different balancer types
Sees only source/dest IP + port — never terminates TLS, never reads the HTTP request.
Fast and cheap, but cannot route by path, header, or cookie.
Sees the full request: path, headers, cookies — costs CPU for TLS termination + parsing.
Enables path-based routing, canary releases, and per-request retries an L4 LB can't do.
ALGORITHMS — the failure mode each answers
fails when request cost varies a lot
tracks live conn count — handles variable cost
a server joining/leaving only moves ITS slice
Passive (LB watches live error rate / latency)
catches the slow-but-up case active checks miss
